notes: Freestanding directive bill (Engrossed in House, EH), 5 sections, ~10K chars, full source read; no referencedSources registered. Analysis is faithful and complete: all figures ($471.9B, 21st, 10th, 7 years, 10 years, 1 year, 1980, Oct 2024), statutory cites (1705(b), 1701(c)(2), 22 U.S.C. 262r(c)(2), Public Law 96-8, Section 4(a)(1)), directions (mandatory 'shall support', discretionary 'may waive', sunset), and the actor (U.S. Governor of the IMF) verify against source. No material errors and no material omissions — every operative provision (4(a) mandate, 4(b) policy, 4(c) waiver, 4(d) sunset, Sec 5 testimony) is covered. Minor rows only: summary/brief gloss 'representative' for 'United States Governor'; top_lines[0].subs[2] drops 'substantially'/'on reporting to Congress'; sense-of-Congress drops 'significance'; 'prior 1980 IMF membership' is a compressed gloss (1980 = PRC seated, not membership start); waiver detail says 'this section' vs source 'subsection (a)' (functionally equal). likelihoodReason carries extrinsic framing ('China's opposition', senators 'may be reluctant') + legislative-status metadata not in bill text (all consistent with cache, left open as style debt). featured_quotes are Congressional Record floor statements, unverifiable within the source-only (bill-text) scope — recorded UNSUPPORTED (unverifiable, not contradicted), not audited for verbatim/stance/attribution.
